\n<Tutorial>You'd like to see other endings, yeah?
\n<Tutorial>There's a total of 14 endings. Three of them can be
reached in Chapter 1 while gathering information,
while the other 11 are all in Chapter 3.
\n<Tutorial>The last two were added with the latest update
and can only be reached in endless endgame mode
after clearing the game with a regular ending.
\n<Tutorial>\c[17]Keep in mind that you can't reach the so-called
True Endings in Endless Mode, so please be careful!\c[0]
(This applies to endings marked with a \I[84].)
\n<Tutorial>If you want to see them all, you should change
things up and do things differently each time.
Try different combinations of conditions.
\n<Tutorial>You could try being very sexually aggressive during
Chapter 1, or do the exact opposite and be a very
respectful lover. Who knows what the future holds?
\n<Tutorial>In the second half of the game, even small changes
in Hazuki can lead to different results. The key to
it all are her Obedience and whether she's pregnant.
\n<Tutorial>Her growing obedient when pregnant or when she's
not... You should try different combinations like this.
(And what if she actually stays a virgin?)
\n<Tutorial>There are also secret Escape endings you can reach.
\n<Tutorial>It's all over quickly for you if Hazuki escapes with
low Obedience... But what if she gets out with 50
or more, after you've trained her a lot?
\n<Tutorial>Finally, for those of you who are very busy and lack
the time, there's also a button to unlock everything.
You can find it in the gallery from the title screen.
\n<Tutorial>That's all I have to share about this for now.

\n<Tutorial>Ah, you'd like to know about maxing Hazuki's stats!
\n<Tutorial>Both Obedience and Escape max out at 100. Their
counterparts in Chapter 1, Affection and Vigilance,
work exactly the same way.
\n<Tutorial>Her training health stats, Stamina and Spirit,
can never go over 100. In a similar fashion, her
Courage and Endurance values max out at 100.
\n<Tutorial>Hazuki's various Sensitivity meters can reach 999.
Her Lewdness can also go that high, but pushing it
to those extremes would take some real effort.
\n<Tutorial>That's all I have to share about this for now.
